summary: Computer Technology graduate with 1,800 hours of hands-on IT and administrative support experience in the shipping and logistics industry. Experienced in manual QA testing of a production biometric attendance system, including test case preparation and execution, pre-release testing, and defect reporting in an Agile/Kanban workflow. Skilled in data entry, basic technical troubleshooting, and testing personal software projects developed with AI-assisted workflows, tracking defects and enhancements through GitHub Issues. Detail-oriented, adaptable, quick to learn new systems, and proficient in typing at 80+ WPM.

coreSkills.items: Manual, Functional & Regression Testing; Test Case Writing & Execution; Release/Pre-Release Testing; Bug Reporting & Tracking; Agile/Kanban Workflows
Basic Hardware/Software Troubleshooting; Hardware & Software Installation & Configuration; End-User Technical Support; Data Entry & Record Verification
HTML, CSS, JavaScript, SQL; Git & GitHub (incl. Issues, Kanban Boards); Visual Studio Code; AI-Assisted Development
Microsoft Excel & Word; Google Sheets & Docs

bullets: Conducted manual QA testing of production updates for BITS, a biometric attendance system, by preparing and executing test cases, performing pre-release checks, and reporting and tracking defects across overtime, shift, punch-time, and reporting workflows.
Tracked sprint tasks using a GitHub Kanban board and workflow stages: To Do, In Progress, Testing, and Done.
Entered and maintained inventory, administrative, and biometric attendance records; checked data for errors and inconsistencies before finalization.
Organized physical and digital records for efficient retrieval and supported the real-time attendance dashboard and related system data.
Provided basic hardware/software troubleshooting, installation, configuration, and general office technical support.

projects.name: ArcaneTyper — Multiplayer Typing Game
bullets: Defined project requirements and guided AI-assisted development of a web-based typing game featuring survival, practice, and real-time duel modes, along with leaderboards, achievements, and user accounts.
Manually tested gameplay modes, scoring, and real-time multiplayer interactions; documented bugs and tracked enhancements through GitHub Issues.

projects.name: Mimic — Android Party Game with Private Encrypted Vault
bullets: Defined requirements and guided AI-assisted development of an Android social-deduction game featuring three game modes, five word packs, LAN multiplayer for up to eight players, and a private encrypted vault for photos, videos, and notes.

Manually tested gameplay and vault-security features, including gesture unlock, PIN setup, failed-PIN lockout, auto-lock, and encrypted video playback. Performed additional testing on a physical device running the release build.
Identified release-specific defects, including a vault setup issue on clean installs, and incorporated clean-install testing on a wiped physical device into the release-testing process.

education.credential: Bachelor of Industrial Technology, Major in Computer Technology
